clips.title: The story
paras: Darren Malvew of Southshore hates losing the town's beautiful horses. Undead, the Syndicate gang and assorted scoundrels have cost plenty, but Darren says nothing threatens them more than the mountain lions that keep coming down from the hills of Alterac.

Darren Malvew of Southshore cannot stand losing the beautiful horses there. Quite a few have been lost to undead creeps, the Syndicate gang and the scoundrels poking about the region. By Darren's own word, though, no menace to the horses is bigger than the mountain lions up in Alterac, forever coming down from the hills.
Darren wants the lions dealt with: eight Mountain Lions and ten Hulking Mountain Lions. Mountain Lions are found in the lower hills of the Alterac Mountains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ain't nothin' that irks me more than losin' these here beautiful horses. And believe me, we've lost quite a few between them pesky undead creeps, the dang Syndicate gang and all the other good-for-nothin' scoundrels pokin' about these parts.
But I swear on my ol' grand-daddy's grave there ain't no bigger menace to our horses here than them Mountain Lions up in Alterac. Always comin' down from the hills and makin' my life difficult!
You fancy yourself a hero? Go and do somethin' about it then!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Mountain Lions killin' off our horses left and right and here you are wantin' to jibber-jabber about the weather and what not.
Ought to go and find myself a real hero. More killin' and less talkin'.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ain't that great news! Should-a gone and found me a regular ol' war hero from day one to take care of them beasts. You'd-a made your pappy proud, friend.
